channel.title: FastKeys guides
channel.description: Practical guides for international students in Maastricht.

item.title: Eating well on a student budget in the Netherlands: where the cheap protein is
item.description: What is actually cheap in Dutch supermarkets, which shops to use for what, and a week of meals that costs less than you would think.

item.title: Buying a bike in Maastricht: what to pay and how not to lose it
item.description: Where to buy, what a fair price looks like, which lock to get, and what to do if it is stolen anyway.

item.title: Where to get furniture in Maastricht without spending a fortune
item.description: Second-hand markets, kringloop shops and the Facebook groups that actually work, plus what is worth buying new.

item.title: Five things to sort out in your first week in the Netherlands
item.description: The short list that unblocks everything else, in the order that actually works.

item.title: Huurtoeslag in 2026: can a student in Maastricht actually get it?
item.description: The rules changed on 1 January 2026. What that means for students, and the one condition that disqualifies most student rooms.

item.title: How to register in Maastricht and get your BSN
item.description: What the gemeente needs, how long it takes, and the two things that catch international students out. A step-by-step for Maastricht.
